headline: Trump Warns Iran Of Severe Retaliation Tonight
summary: President Trump announced potential severe retaliation against Iran, following military exchanges in which the US and Iran traded strikes after Iranian attacks on ships. Trump declared the ceasefire over at a NATO summit in Turkey.
why: Escalation between the US and Iran affects oil supply routes through the Gulf, making crude prices and risk assets sensitive to developments.
why_moved: The ceasefire was declared over after US-Iran strikes and attacks on ships, raising the risk of wider disruption to Gulf oil shipping.
